title: Area of a Triangle Using Trigonometry (½ab sin C): Proof, Worked Examples and Syllabus
seoTitle: Area of a Triangle Using Trigonometry: ½ab sin C
seoDescription: Area of a triangle = ½ab sin C, using two sides and the angle between them. See the proof, obtuse-angle and land-plot examples and common mistakes.
excerpt: Five worked examples, including a corner plot converted to square feet and guntha, a table showing when to use Heron's formula instead, the radian-mode trap, and where the formula sits in CBSE, state board and NDA syllabuses.
